text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":20,"unit":"minutes","kind":"count","span":"20 minutes for the oil to heat up to 300 degrees"},{"id":"q2","value":300,"unit":"degrees","kind":"count","span":"300 degrees"},{"id":"q3","value":40,"unit":"%","kind":"count","span":"40% longer"},{"id":"q4","value":400,"unit":"degrees","kind":"count","span":"400 degrees"},{"id":"q5","value":5,"unit":"minutes","kind":"count","span":"5 minutes less time to cook"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"multiply the first warming time (20) by the percentage number (40) to represent the \"40% longer\" extra amount of time"},{"op":"add","args":["q1","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"add that extra amount to the original 20 minutes to get phase-two's warming time (to 400 degrees)"},{"op":"add","args":["q1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"add phase-one and phase-two warming times together for the total warming time"},{"op":"sub","args":["s3","q5"],"out":"s4","note":"subtract 5 minutes from the total warming time to get the cooking time"},{"op":"add","args":["s3","s4"],"out":"s5","note":"add total warming time and cooking time together for the overall elapsed time"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total time in minutes from starting the oil to having cooked chicken"},"dismissed":[{"value":300,"reason":"names the temperature reached after the first warming phase, not a duration needed to compute elapsed time"},{"value":400,"reason":"names the final desired temperature, not a duration needed to compute elapsed time"}]}
